_comment: Single source of truth for the SpongeSquad website. The build reads `modules` to compile each app into dist/, and every page reads `stages`, `sections` and `workstreams` to draw navigation. Paths are relative to the site root, so the site works under any subpath. To replace a placeholder, edit the workstream's own index.html and update its `status` here.

stages.label: Find
stages.question: Where in Basel might a heat-and-water intervention be worth investigating?

stages.label: Understand
stages.question: What is known about the selected place, and what is not?

stages.label: Design
stages.question: What can change, and which measures depend on one another?

stages.label: Test
stages.question: How might rainwater move differently after the change?

stages.label: See
stages.question: Can a person see and follow the changed street system?

stages.label: Decide
stages.question: Who can act, what evidence is required, and how could a proposal advance?

workstreams.title: Site scoping and hot-spot finder
workstreams.summary: React and Leaflet map, dataset catalogue, provisional scoring, shortlist and comparison.

workstreams.title: Street Lab
workstreams.summary: Typed synthetic street, rain-garden intervention, conserved water balance and React/SVG view.

workstreams.title: Sponge Street explainer (early prototype)
workstreams.summary: Standalone explainer with seven intervention tracks and twelve guided states.

workstreams.title: Street X-Ray evidence gate
workstreams.summary: One study point: what is known, what is only a hypothesis, and what must be unlocked before design.

workstreams.title: Rain Walk (street evidence campaign)
workstreams.summary: Demo campaign for recording street observations with review history and an evidence passport. Synthetic, browser-local.

workstreams.title: Data Charter map
workstreams.summary: City-wide evidence charter: what Basel publishes, what is inferred and what is missing.

workstreams.title: Wrapper and integration
workstreams.summary: Shared shell, contracts, architecture records and integration of the modules.

workstreams.title: Frontend
workstreams.summary: Shared product interface. Template page until the frontend exposes an entry point.

workstreams.title: Data and provenance
workstreams.summary: Datasets, schemas, transformations and provenance for the map and the street.

workstreams.title: Explainers and context
workstreams.summary: Explanations and video assets. Template page until assets are added.

workstreams.title: Presentation and story
workstreams.summary: Demo narrative and slides. The Canva deck is linked; the story page is a template.
